records.text: Michael Savage said something was wrong with the government's account and challenged the claim that the shooter removed a Mauser barrel and packed the rifle parts within two seconds
records.speaker: Michael Savage

appearances.snippet: Something's wrong with the whole thing. They're trying to claim he removed the barrel from the Mauser and fit the receiver and stock in his backpack and barrel in his pants leg, all in two seconds.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous coverage with the circulated video reproduces Michael Savage saying something was wrong and challenging a claimed two-second barrel-removal scenario. This verifies that Savage made the quoted challenge. It does not establish that the government itself made that exact barrel-removal claim; official FBI material reviewed says a bolt-action rifle was recovered but does not state that its barrel was removed within two seconds.
